home.title: Living documentation that lives with your code
home.subtitle: LivingDocs connects your codebase to its documentation: every workspace's purpose, drift detection, review queues, and AI-assisted generation — all in one place.
home.feature1Body: Drift detection runs whenever your code changes, surfacing what needs review.
home.feature2Body: Templates guide the AI so generated docs follow your team's conventions.
home.feature3Body: Group related services and share templates, knowledge, and reviews across them.
home.reviewBody: Every change goes through a human-in-the-loop checkpoint. AI drafts are suggestions, not commits.
home.healthBody: Freshness, coverage, drift and confidence scores roll up into one dashboard per workspace.

aiSettings.embeddingModelDesc: Used to build the vector index for the knowledge base. Leave blank to inherit the provider default.
aiSettings.thresholdDesc: Minimum confidence for the AI to auto-approve a generated version (or auto-flag it for review).
aiSettings.thresholdHelp: 0.00 accepts every suggestion; 1.00 only accepts what the model certifies as high-confidence. 0.70 is a reasonable starting point.

adminUsers.title: Admin · Users
adminUsers.subtitle: Manage platform users and their platform roles. Roles are enforced by the API — your own account cannot be disabled from here.
adminUsers.cannotDisableSelf: You cannot disable your own account.
adminUsers.cannotRemoveAllRoles: Cannot remove all roles — disable the account instead.

adminRoles.title: Admin · Roles
adminRoles.subtitle: Catalogue of platform roles. Role codes are immutable identifiers used by the API and audit log; names and descriptions are editable to keep the UI accurate as the organization evolves.
adminRoles.howItWorksP1: Each authenticated request resolves the user's active role codes from the
adminRoles.howItWorksP1Mid: table and grants them as Spring Security authorities (prefixed with
adminRoles.howItWorksP3: The five seeded roles — DEVELOPER, STAFF, TECHNICAL_LEAD, MANAGER, ADMIN — are immutable identifiers. Adding new platform roles requires a new Flyway migration so JWTs and audit payloads remain compatible.

DEVELOPER.name: Developer
DEVELOPER.description: Default member. Can view and contribute to documentation in workspaces they belong to.

STAFF.name: Staff (Reviewer)
STAFF.description: Reviews documentation changes submitted by AI or Developers in the approval workflow.

TECHNICAL_LEAD.name: Technical Lead
TECHNICAL_LEAD.description: Combines Staff review duties with the ability to approve documentation changes and manage workspace technical settings.

MANAGER.name: Manager (Approver)
MANAGER.description: Final approver in the documentation approval workflow. Manages workspace membership and repository connections.

ADMIN.name: Administrator
ADMIN.description: Full platform access. Manages users, roles, integrations, AI settings and audit retention.

audit_log.description: Platform audit log entries. Increase for compliance regimes.

about.hero: LivingDocs keeps your documentation next to your code — automatically generated, AI-assisted, and always in sync with your repository.
about.githubDesc: Your source code lives here. LivingDocs listens to pushes and pull requests to detect drift and trigger documentation updates.
about.backendDesc: Spring Boot API manages documents, versions, templates, drift alerts, and workspace membership. Persists everything to PostgreSQL.
about.aiServiceDesc: An independent Python service that generates markdown from code, detects semantic drift, and links documents to source entities.
about.rm1Title: GitHub integration — PR workflows, automated drift detection
about.rm1Desc: Connect repositories, link documents, and trigger AI reviews on pull requests.
about.rm2Desc: Generate and update documentation from source code using AI models.
about.rm3Title: Role-based access control — Member, Staff, Manager, Admin
about.rm3Desc: Fine-grained permissions for who can view, edit, review, and publish documents.
about.rm4Title: Notifications, activity feed, and Slack/email digests
about.rm4Desc: Keep your team informed about drift alerts, review requests, and new versions.
